claim: The complete 20-map v26 co-op tree passes a fresh one-minute-per-map native soak, and the v27 successor closes the remaining observed Commando and Guardian joint warnings in focused native runs. Severe actor skeleton, missing-animation, unknown-joint, no-model-on-actor, error, and fatal log families are zero in the applicable acceptance runs.
repairs: Guardian gameplay resources are complete and its Xbox-pruned focus, look, and tongue-smoke joints resolve to the nearest retained bind-pose joints.
Hellhole gameplay Cyberdemon pain clips resolve to validated 78-joint PC retargets before the raw 50-joint Xbox cinematic family.
Stock-PC cinematic Imp declarations use private PC aliases and cannot inherit the 41-joint Xbox gameplay mesh.
Private 48-joint Xbox NPC declarations pin their bind, IK, stand, walk, gib, and body mesh resources; Mars City co-op heads alias neutral stand to their shipped idle.
The Xbox 50-joint Commando ragdoll uses a byte-faithful stock AF copy with its pruned Lindex3 endpoint mapped to retained Lhand.
The duplicate Cyber rocket noshadows epair is removed without altering projectile tuning.
remaining_observed_content_gaps: Eight named static render paths remain absent: keycard2.lwo, recycwallight_broken.ase, xc_caves1_6.ASE, Blobfingers_vv.lwo, mouth_vv.lwo, hellhole_cyb_chop3.lwo, and the two Hellhole first-room component names.

The locally recovered Xbox payload contains collision-only CM.X counterparts for the Xbox-specific Site 3, Caverns, and Hellhole props; it does not contain their UV/material render meshes. Collision hulls are not substituted as fabricated render assets.

Comm1 still emits Couldn't load gui: '50' from the terminal carrying authentic gui_distance 50; its explicit gui path is valid and the map remains alive, so the gameplay-distance epair is retained pending a source-proven compatibility mapping.
idDict::FindKey empty-key warnings remain in seven map logs and require call-site attribution before content mutation.
This checkpoint does not accept two-peer progression, encounter fidelity, visual comparison, save/load, or every remaining warning.
